page: Amazon Web Services t8i.small is an entry-level virtual instance belonging to the General Purpose family, utilizing the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features a burstable CPU allocation model powered by an Intel x86_64 processor clocked at 3.9 GHz. Compute resources comprise two virtual CPUs derived from a single physical core with two threads per core, paired with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 1.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators or local instance storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is listed at 0 Gbps, reflecting dynamic or burstable network allocation characteristics typical of smaller burstable instances. The instance operates without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on private networking or separate routing configurations.

From an architectural perspective, the burstable CPU profile provides intermittent access to high clock speeds while balancing infrastructure cost for low-utilization scenarios. The memory configuration of 2.0 GB restricts heavy in-memory operations, making the instance primarily suited for lightweight background tasks, development environments, microservices, small web proxies, and low-traffic automation jobs.
